title: Spotlight publish, website publish and Space campaign send are counted in analytics

source.ref: Space function scan 2026-11-17 (project thread: Trace every Space feature end to end)

detail: The launch flow records its own events (lib/launch/events.ts) and Create a Space has nine funnel signals, but the moments a creator reaches in the console after launch emit nothing: publishing a Spotlight from the console, publishing the website (lib/sites/editor/actions.ts, setWebsitePublished), and sending a Space campaign. So activation past the launch flow cannot be measured. Register space.spotlight_published, space.website_published and space.campaign_sent (server-only, ids and counts only, first-party) and emit them at those three points.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
